subject: Night Passage five weapon identities and attack choreography
verdict: Delivered as lightweight authored weapons with distinct basic/special poses; precise two-hand contact remains polish.

coverage.playback: Ten attack/special cases, legal commands at 60 ticks per second, unretimed 1x recording; separate 16-clip raw playback.

review: Native studio views distinguish the broad beveled blade, long leaf spear, enamel kite shield, recurved bow and paired ceramic gauntlets. Grip origins and materials remain editable.
Production actor captures preserve attachment and weapon scale; both gauntlets follow their own hand. Basic and special poses have distinct preparation/contact/recovery.
Bow string Draw follows confirmed windup; the nocked arrow tracks the string, disappears at release and returns at rest.
Live chamber capture retains player silhouette, warning readability and health bar. Native and browser views were visually inspected; automated agreement is a separate criterion.
corrections: Added the second hand socket without changing saved hero mesh or weights.
Added five special actions and a left punch, preserving unrelated saved clips.
Corrected bow grip origin and retained native axis conversion under hand sockets.
Made the nocked arrow follow Draw from its saved rest transform; repeated sampling does not accumulate offsets.
Exported a dense morph to match the existing repository GLB accessor checker.

geometryAgreement.heroSampling: Every authored 30fps frame, 16 surface vertices per named mesh
geometryAgreement.weaponUnits: game units; every native and exported vertex at Draw 0, 0.5, 1

weapons.edit: Extend saved sword tip by eight game units, save/reload/export

limits: Owner review is not user acceptance or independent art direction.
Two-hand bow string contact, free-hand spear support, dedicated strafing and hit reactions remain later polish.
Enemies, guardians and environment kits remain gameplay blockouts.
The previous visual-review.json and its evidence preserve the first hero batch hashes; this report pins the current delivery.

delegation.task: Sol integration of weapon loading, shared-phase choreography and lifecycle tests; separate read-only review
delegation.outcome: Worker completed the bounded adapter slice and 16 focused tests; review found arrow tracking issue, repaired by same worker. Root owned native art, browser integration and visual review.
delegation.efficiency: Useful separation of native authoring and TypeScript work; no controlled baseline timing comparison or speedup claim.
